# Constants & iota

## Konstanta dengan `const`

Konstanta adalah nilai yang **tidak dapat diubah** setelah dideklarasikan. Konstanta dievaluasi saat kompilasi.

```go
const Pi = 3.14159
const AppName = "GoApp"
const MaxRetry = 3

// Pi = 4.0  // ERROR! Tidak bisa mengubah konstanta
```

## Typed vs Untyped Constants

```go
// Typed constant — memiliki tipe eksplisit
const typedPi float64 = 3.14159

// Untyped constant — lebih fleksibel, tipe ditentukan saat digunakan
const untypedPi = 3.14159

var f32 float32 = untypedPi  // OK: untyped bisa digunakan sebagai float32
var f64 float64 = untypedPi  // OK: juga bisa float64
// var f32b float32 = typedPi  // ERROR: typedPi adalah float64
```

## Const Group

```go
const (
    StatusOK       = 200
    StatusNotFound = 404
    StatusError    = 500

    AppVersion = "2.0.0"
    MaxWorkers = 10
)
```

## `iota` — Auto-increment untuk Konstanta

`iota` adalah penghitung yang dimulai dari **0** dan bertambah 1 setiap baris dalam blok `const`:

```go
const (
    Minggu  = iota // 0
    Senin          // 1
    Selasa         // 2
    Rabu           // 3
    Kamis          // 4
    Jumat          // 5
    Sabtu          // 6
)

fmt.Println(Senin, Rabu, Sabtu) // 1 3 6
```

## iota dengan Ekspresi Aritmatika

```go
const (
    _  = iota             // 0 (diabaikan dengan _)
    KB = 1 << (10 * iota) // 1 << 10 = 1024
    MB                    // 1 << 20 = 1048576
    GB                    // 1 << 30 = 1073741824
    TB                    // 1 << 40
)

fmt.Printf("1 KB = %d bytes\n", KB)  // 1024
fmt.Printf("1 MB = %d bytes\n", MB)  // 1048576
fmt.Printf("1 GB = %d bytes\n", GB)  // 1073741824
```

## Enum dengan iota (Direction)

```go
type Direction int

const (
    North Direction = iota  // 0
    East                    // 1
    South                   // 2
    West                    // 3
)

func (d Direction) String() string {
    return [...]string{"North", "East", "South", "West"}[d]
}

fmt.Println(North) // North
fmt.Println(East)  // East
```

## iota Mulai dari Nilai Tertentu

```go
const (
    Level1 = iota + 1  // 1 (bukan 0)
    Level2             // 2
    Level3             // 3
)

const (
    HTTP  = iota * 100  // 0
    FTP                 // 100
    SSH                 // 200
    SMTP                // 300
)
```
content_en:
# Constants & iota

## Constants with `const`

Constants are values that **cannot be changed** after declaration. They are evaluated at compile time.

```go
const Pi = 3.14159
const AppName = "GoApp"
const MaxRetry = 3

// Pi = 4.0  // ERROR! Cannot change a constant
```

## Typed vs Untyped Constants

```go
// Typed constant — has an explicit type
const typedPi float64 = 3.14159

// Untyped constant — more flexible, type determined at usage
const untypedPi = 3.14159

var f32 float32 = untypedPi  // OK: untyped can be used as float32
var f64 float64 = untypedPi  // OK: also works as float64
// var f32b float32 = typedPi  // ERROR: typedPi is float64
```

## Const Group

```go
const (
    StatusOK       = 200
    StatusNotFound = 404
    StatusError    = 500

    AppVersion = "2.0.0"
    MaxWorkers = 10
)
```

## `iota` — Auto-increment for Constants

`iota` is a counter starting at **0** that increments by 1 with each line in a `const` block:

```go
const (
    Sunday    = iota // 0
    Monday           // 1
    Tuesday          // 2
    Wednesday        // 3
    Thursday         // 4
    Friday           // 5
    Saturday         // 6
)

fmt.Println(Monday, Wednesday, Saturday) // 1 3 6
```

## iota with Arithmetic Expressions

```go
const (
    _  = iota             // 0 (discarded with _)
    KB = 1 << (10 * iota) // 1 << 10 = 1024
    MB                    // 1 << 20 = 1048576
    GB                    // 1 << 30 = 1073741824
    TB                    // 1 << 40
)

fmt.Printf("1 KB = %d bytes\n", KB)  // 1024
fmt.Printf("1 MB = %d bytes\n", MB)  // 1048576
fmt.Printf("1 GB = %d bytes\n", GB)  // 1073741824
```

## Enum with iota (Direction)

```go
type Direction int

const (
    North Direction = iota  // 0
    East                    // 1
    South                   // 2
    West                    // 3
)

func (d Direction) String() string {
    return [...]string{"North", "East", "South", "West"}[d]
}

fmt.Println(North) // North
fmt.Println(East)  // East
```

## iota Starting from a Specific Value

```go
const (
    Level1 = iota + 1  // 1 (not 0)
    Level2             // 2
    Level3             // 3
)

const (
    HTTP  = iota * 100  // 0
    FTP                 // 100
    SSH                 // 200
    SMTP                // 300
)
```
starterCode:
package main

import "fmt"

const (
	AppName = "BelajarGo"
	Version = "1.0.0"
	MaxUsers = 100
)

type Weekday int

const (
	Sunday Weekday = iota
	Monday
	Tuesday
	Wednesday
	Thursday
	Friday
	Saturday
)

const (
	_  = iota
	KB = 1 << (10 * iota)
	MB
	GB
)

func main() {
	fmt.Printf("App: %s v%s, MaxUsers: %d\n", AppName, Version, MaxUsers)
	fmt.Printf("Hari ke-1: %d (Monday)\n", Monday)
	fmt.Printf("Hari ke-5: %d (Friday)\n", Friday)
	fmt.Printf("1 KB = %d bytes\n", KB)
	fmt.Printf("1 MB = %d bytes\n", MB)
	fmt.Printf("1 GB = %d bytes\n", GB)
}
